## 🌎 Major world changes

- **Shift in US data infrastructure policy:** President Trump's call for severe taxes on American tech firms building data centers overseas signals a **major protectionist shift in technology capital expenditure**. If enacted, the policy would force multi-billion-dollar AI compute infrastructure investments to remain within domestic US borders, disrupting international expansion strategies for hyperscale cloud operators and impacting real estate and energy developments in partner nations like India. - **Claim:** The entire Nvidia board of directors resigned en masse following executive departures.
  - **Verdict:** ❌ **False**

## 🛡️ Scams & safety alerts

- **Hyderabad student job and crypto scam:** A 21-year-old student from Madannapet, Hyderabad, lost **₹3.62 lakh** after responding to a fake WhatsApp message offering part-time Amazon task reviews linked to an fraudulent bitcoin trading platform. [[Hyderabad Mail]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNalZTNjAwWXBnYkotZHlqa0doYUp3YzdMSl9IWTZXbE9XNWpveDlSeUdLSDBoZ2NIcFBtMXVFQlZ3M216V21GVTkxQXRtMGlVaW93bUQ4emk2c2JxWjVDMWFwdzh3T2F6UDRyZUl1NjY3ZndwR2RiUFRDNUVtbHc3SklKcVo2MGU4MVVreVpvdE10UQ?oc=5)
  - **What to do:** Never pay upfront money or deposit funds into unverified cryptocurrency wallets for part-time online rating jobs.

- **Fake GTA 6 PC download malware:** Security agencies warned gamers against downloading unofficial "GTA VI PC setup files." Malicious websites are distributing a **$200 malware kit** that steals browser credentials and crypto wallet keys. [[The Times of India]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5)
  - **What to do:** Download video games exclusively from official distribution platforms like Steam, Epic Games Store, or publisher websites.

- **Staples Canada data breach:** Staples Canada notified customers that an unauthorized third party accessed **customer order names, delivery addresses, and contact numbers**. [[Toronto Star]](https://news.google.?oc=5)
  - **What to do:** Be vigilant against suspicious emails or text messages claiming to be package delivery tracking updates.

## 🎓 Today's lesson

- **Market Correction:** A market correction occurs when a major stock index (such as the S&P 500 or Nasdaq) **falls by 10% to 20% from its recent peak**. Unlike a "bear market" (which is a decline of 20% or more), a correction is often a short-term rebalancing where investors sell overvalued stocks to lock in profits or adjust to changing economic conditions. For example, yesterday's tech sell-off pushed the S&P 500 down 3.70% on the day and over 10% below its high, officially triggering a market correction.
